title: Crash recovery of a committed write
contract: With atomic durable commit marker and value persistence, recovery exposes old state before commit and new state after commit.
scope: Crash cut 0 before prepare, 1 after prepare, 2 after commit; durable protocol flag; old values 0..2; admission durable flag.
assumptions: Only admitted inputs within the finite model; outside-assumption probes are recorded separately and are not contract failures.

obligations.claim: Commit marker reflects whether commit occurred.
Recovered value equals old before commit and old+1 after commit.

variants.description: Expose prepared value even without commit marker.
Recover by selecting from committed log records.
